---
title: "LaTeX"
---

Install TeX Live for LaTeX document production, the TeXstudio editor, and supporting utilities.

```sh
ansible-playbook -i inventory -K playbooks/lab-stack.yml --tags latex
```

By default, the role installs `texlive-scheme-full`, plus TeXstudio and `untex`.
The full scheme is large, but provides a comprehensive TeX Live environment without
requiring individual TeX Live packages to be selected.

## Use the selected-package installation

To avoid the large full scheme, set the following variable in your Ansible inventory or group variables:

```yaml
latex_install_texlive_scheme_full: false
```

The role then installs the packages in `latex_texlive_packages` instead of `texlive-scheme-full`.
The default selected set provides German language support, additional LaTeX packages, and XeTeX:

```yaml
latex_texlive_packages:
  - texlive-lang-german
  - texlive-latex-extra
  - texlive-xetex
```

Use `latex_additional_packages` to configure utilities installed with either TeX Live
option. Its defaults install the TeXstudio graphical editor and `untex`:

```yaml
latex_additional_packages:
  - texstudio
  - untex
```

::: {.callout-check}
**✅ Check**

```sh
pdflatex --version
xelatex --version
texstudio --version
```
:::
